description: Recomputes one EOB line or claim total from the printed amounts (billed, allowed, plan paid, deductible, copay, coinsurance, non-covered, patient responsibility) and reports the contractual adjustment, the expected patient responsibility and plan payment, and any discrepancy such as a balance bill or a mismatched total. Use it when a user gives EOB or bill amounts and asks whether what they owe is right; it returns an itemized, exact calculation with stated assumptions. Pure arithmetic; takes dollar amounts only, never names or identifiers.

allowed.description: Plan's allowed, approved or eligible amount.

billed.description: Provider's billed charge for the line or claim.

coinsurance_rate.description: Coinsurance percentage, for example 20 or 0.2, if the dollar amount is not printed.

in_network.description: false for an out-of-network claim. Defaults to true.

non_covered.description: Non-covered amount the statement assigns to the patient (PR group), if any.

patient_responsibility.description: Total the statement says the patient owes.

name: check_eob_math
title: Check EOB arithmetic
